'''2011 Worlds Day 2 David Mearns DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Mearns]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Too Lazy To Make My Own Deck'''. L1 [[Endor Operations]]; L2 Endor. L11 sheet Black Leader (V) → DS-61-2 (V); L16 is DS-61-2 not (V). L13 sheet Galen Ship (V) entered as Galen Marek, Starkiller (V) (no ship by that name; uncertain). L21–22 sheet EPP Maul → Darth Maul. L26 one-word Seeker entered as Luke Seeker (Han Seeker possible). L51 sheet Sgt. Elsen → Sergeant Major Enfield (uncertain). L54 sheet Imperial Banner entered as The Empire's Back (uncertain). Shield 11 scribble read as Alter (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations]]
